results.detail: Re-derived from DTSX:15: MAX(dateadd(hh,3,gen_revaluationdate)) over Gen_fundmain where gen_existinfile = 1 and gen_revaluationdate < "yyyy/m/1" string, CONVERT style 103, then UPDATE [gen_SystemConfigurationBase] set gen_Value where gen_name = MaxRevaluationDate. The filter compares the raw value and the +3h can roll the stored date to the next day when the max time >= 21:00 (correct). Unsupported direct SQL is correct. The flag is stated neutrally (no unproven meaning).
